blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Despite the Senate Impeachment Court not admitting some audit reports as evidence for the unexplained wealth charge against Vice President Sara Duterte, public prosecutor and Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon considers it as a win since most of their presentations were considered. In a video statement on Friday, Ridon thanked the Senate Impeachment Court for admitting most of the evidence presented by the prosecution throughout Duterte’s formal trial, which started last July 6. “Nagpapasalamat po kami sa Senate Impeachment Court sa pagtanggap ng karamihan sa mga ebidensya na inilatag ng prosekusyon sa aming formal offer of evidence,” Ridon […]...
